checks.name: Natural notes alternate exact staff lines and spaces
Sharps share the natural note position and use sharp spelling
Octaves preserve seven diatonic steps and 28 points
E2 and C7 fit the fixed 160-point canvas
Absent, invalid, low confidence and out-of-range pitches are rejected
Staff following accepts G2 through C6 and rejects neighboring notes without clamping
Hysteresis prevents semitone boundary chatter
First missing melody waits faintly on B4
Fresh targets preserve position and movement starts on the next refresh
Accepted targets and repeated notes settle within 150ms
High-confidence intrusions lasting up to five frames leave no pitch spikes
Brief out-of-range bursts hold the last pitch and add no trace or edge notes
Returning from a brief rejected range keeps a continuous trace without adding rejected samples
Persistent out-of-range sound expires the label without moving or extending the trail
Out-of-range sound at startup does not invent a boundary note
Unconfirmed jumps pause the trail instead of appending held or guessed pitches
Confirmed jumps join the previous reliable point across a short confirmation interval
Missing pitch expires its live tail even while accompaniment continues
Pitch after a stale gap starts a fresh trace segment
Real silence still breaks the trace immediately
Brief filtering gaps stay connected; stale input never draws a held-note tail
A continuous visual tail expires with its eight-second history instead of persisting indefinitely
Semitone and whole-tone vocal motion changes the target on its first frame
Sustained thirds, fifths and octaves require 100, 125 and 150ms and confirm within one hop
Confirmed jumps keep their full staff distance and the trail reaches the true note
A melodic phrase with thirds and fourths keeps notes sustained beyond confirmation
Unrelated high and low candidates cannot accumulate into a confirmed jump

Repeated snapshots cannot confirm a jump or append trajectory points
Widely spaced observations cannot be treated as continuous confirmation
Unconfirmed candidates do not keep an old reliable pitch alive indefinitely

Missing melody clears pending candidates but a confirmed note joins the audible phrase
A rejected range interrupts candidate continuity rather than joining two short bursts

C4 returns to the same height after low/high phrases and input resets
Holding C4 for four more seconds never recenters the note or its target
A later low phrase cannot shift existing C4 history or compress its octave distance
Repeated snapshots cannot adapt the volume range without new audio
Steady sustained sound does not produce artificial size pulses
Invalid audio cannot corrupt the adaptive volume range
One onset sways across both sides and decays back to the center
Rotational sway keeps the solid head center fixed at its exact staff position
Successive onsets alternate their initial rotation direction
Ordinary musical dynamics visibly change size while preserving pitch and base motion
Dense onsets preserve a fixed pivot, continuous rotation and bounded tilt
Trace preserves the accepted note and ignores loudness and decorative sway
Trace capacity never exceeds 512 samples
History moves left in real time and fades
All history expires after eight seconds, including long scheduling gaps
Unreliable pitch holds the last height and fades the label
Sound without melody holds pitch, stops history and still follows onsets
Silence stops kicks while existing sway settles smoothly
Snapshot and event duplicates do not replay actions or trajectory
Cached melody expires even when the snapshot remains fresh
Stale audio cannot move the note or start actions
Reconnect isolates old history and accepts the new generation
Audio format changes discard old history and queued kicks

Hidden session stops consuming and clears hidden history
Resume rejects an expired hidden snapshot
Resume starts a fresh trajectory from current reliable input
Disconnected state holds height and lets existing history fade
Brief missing melody keeps the reliable trajectory connected
Explicit unvoiced singing stops the label, sway and live tail while accompaniment continues
A vocal rest does not create history or reposition the last note
The next sung phrase starts at its real pitch with no bridge across the rest

New channel onsets animate immediately while a large pitch jump is pending
